steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect circuit breaker or power cable before servicing electrical parts. Reconnect panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the circuit breaker or power cable before servicing.

steps.title: 120 VAC at outlet?
steps.body: Measure voltage at power outlet. Normal: AC 120 V.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure voltage at power outlet. Normal: AC 120 V.

steps.title: Correct customer power
steps.body: Connect to proper 120 V source or repair outlet wiring.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Connect to proper 120 V source or repair outlet wiring.

steps.title: 120 VAC at CN101?
steps.body: Measure between live and neutral at CN101 on main PBA. Normal: AC 120 V.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure between live and neutral at CN101 on main PBA. Normal: AC 120 V.

steps.title: Repair power harness
steps.body: Check and replace power cable or CN101 connections.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check and replace power cable or CN101 connections.

steps.title: Inspect Sub / Touch / Main harness
steps.body: Reseat Sub PBA, Touch PBA, CN101, and CN802 main-to-sub connectors. Check for condensation on CN103 and CON100.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reseat Sub PBA, Touch PBA, CN101, and CN802 main-to-sub connectors. Check for condensation on CN103 and CON100.

steps.title: Power relay drive 10.5–13 V with door closed?
steps.body: Measure CN402 pin 7 to pin 2 on main PBA. Door open or before cycle: ~1 V. After door closed and cycle started: 10.5–13 V.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure CN402 pin 7 to pin 2 on main PBA. Door open or before cycle: ~1 V. After door closed and cycle started: 10.5–13 V.

steps.title: Power relay output 110–120 V?
steps.body: With cycle started, measure Power Relay pin 3 to CN101 pin 1 (neutral). Normal: 110–120 VAC while operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: With cycle started, measure Power Relay pin 3 to CN101 pin 1 (neutral). Normal: 110–120 VAC while operating.

steps.title: Door switch enables 12 V relay line?
steps.body: White wire door switch: OFF when door open, ON when closed. Faulty door switch blocks Power and Heater relays.
steps.sourceExcerpt: White wire door switch: OFF when door open, ON when closed. Faulty door switch blocks Power and Heater relays.

steps.title: Replace door switch
steps.body: Replace door sensing switch when relay line blocked.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace door sensing switch when relay line blocked.

steps.title: Replace main PBA
steps.body: Replace main PBA when harness and door switch good but relay fails.
steps.oemOutcome: Replace main PBA when harness and door switch good but relay fails.

steps.title: Power path verified
steps.body: Incoming power and relay path verified.
steps.oemOutcome: Incoming power and relay path verified.
